description: This file defines the GrainInterfaceTypeResolver class, which associates grain interface types with Type objects, using configured providers and conventions. It includes methods for retrieving and constructing GrainInterfaceType instances based on interface types, with support for generic parameters.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving GrainInterfaceType instances from interface Types, using providers and conventions.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceTypeResolver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resolver with a collection of providers and a type converter.

methods.name: GetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the GrainInterfaceType for a given interface Type, using providers or fallback conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainInterfaceTypeByConvention
methods.description: Generates a GrainInterfaceType based on default naming conventions for a given interface Type.

methods.name: AddGenericParameters
methods.description: Adds generic parameters to a GrainInterfaceType if the interface Type is a constructed generic type.
